A-TGT-TGT10-PB12.name: Leader 12% pullback (SQ11-PB12), sell at a +10% profit target (time exit at 126 kept)
A-TGT-TGT10-PB12.rule: SQ11-PB12 trades (buy the next open). Sell at buy x 1.10 on the first session whose high reaches it (at the open if the stock opened above it); otherwise sell at the close of session 126. Judged under the full standard; ADOPT only if, in both halves, it fired on 10+ trades, improved the same-window average over all trades (cash 0% after an early sale) and did not lower the per-year return of capital.
